titleJa: ほしをさがすロケット
title: Starbound Rocket
description: Painted paper-tube rocket with cut-card fins, craters and a hand-drawn moon.
memo: 紙の筒に色をぬって羽をつけたロケット。手がきの月もうかんでいるよ

title: Rainbow Sailboat
description: A built cardboard hull with ribs, paper sails, twisted cord rigging and layered painted waves.
memo: 段ボールの船に紙の帆をはって、ひもでつないだよ。波も重ねてかいたよ

titleJa: もりのステゴサウルス
title: The Cardboard Stegosaurus
description: A laminated cardboard dinosaur with tube legs, individual back plates and a miniature paper forest.
memo: 段ボールを重ねた恐竜。背中の板を一枚ずつつけて、紙の森も作ったよ

title: Shoebox Aquarium
description: An open shoebox reef with hanging cutout fish, folded seaweed and a sculpted paper turtle.
memo: くつの箱の中に海を作ったよ。魚をつるして、紙のカメも泳いでいるよ

title: Pocket Solar System
description: A freestanding cardboard mobile with painted paper-mache planets, threads and a real Saturn ring.
memo: 紙ねんどの惑星に色をぬって、糸でつるしたよ。土星のわっかもあるよ

title: Butterfly Meadow
description: Individually folded patterned paper wings above a bouquet of creased paper flowers.
memo: もようの紙をおってちょうちょにしたよ。紙の花たばの上をとんでいるよ

title: Rainbow Express
description: A paper-tube steam engine with a windowed cab, eight spoked wheels, couplers and a loaded wagon.
memo: 紙の筒で作った汽車。車輪を八つつけて、荷物をのせた車両もひっぱるよ

title: Forest Birdhouse
description: A real open birdhouse in corrugated board, with individually laid roof shingles and a perched paper bird.
memo: 段ボールで作った小鳥の家。屋根を一枚ずつはって、紙の小鳥もとまっているよ

title: Tulip Windmill
description: A small paper windmill with open lattice sails, a dimensional mill house, and folded tulips.
memo: 紙で作った風車の家。はねを格子にして、まわりにチューリップをおったよ

title: Memory Camera
description: A recycled-card camera with paper lens barrels, a twine strap and original tiny crayon photo cards.
memo: 空き箱で作ったカメラ。紙のレンズとひものストラップ、クレヨンの写真つき

title: Little Fire Engine
description: A dimensional card fire engine with open cab windows, a lattice ladder and a wound cotton hose.
memo: 厚紙で作った消防車。はしごを組んで、ホースは綿の糸をまいたよ

title: Little Bakery
description: A tiny card bakery with a striped folded awning, miniature clay breads, baskets and paper bags.
memo: 厚紙の小さなパン屋さん。しましまの屋根と、ねんどのパンをならべたよ

title: The Wishwheel
description: Two corrugated wheel rings, eight independently assembled gondolas, A-frame supports and a tiny ticket booth.
memo: 段ボールで作った観覧車。ゴンドラを八つつけて、きっぷ売り場もあるよ
